description: Released compliance bundles approved for hosted grading. Stable aliases advance only through this manifest; package_only_versions remain SDK opt-in surfaces and are not hosted protocol releases.
hosted_advancement_policy: Register a version only after its immutable dist/compliance and dist/schemas artifacts exist, release provenance is available, and the pinned hosted @adcp/sdk can load the bundle. Alias advancement is independent of scheduler health; exact version targets remain pinned.
